description:
Two agent-surface honesty defects, both live, both small.

1. THE OPENAPI DESCRIPTION MAKES A CLAIM THE SPEC DISPROVES. GET https://marquee.stage11.dev/api/openapi.json -> info.description says verbatim: 'Mutations carry strong ETag/If-Match optimistic concurrency.' Counted from the served document: 'If-Match' occurs EXACTLY ONCE in the whole 389KB spec — and that occurrence IS this sentence. There are 116 mutating operations and ZERO header parameters across all 194 operations. The real coverage is 2 routes of 194, agenda only (src/api/concurrency.ts).

This is the most checkable false claim we ship and the API serves it about itself. Fix: narrow the sentence to the truth (agenda mutations carry strong ETag/If-Match) or delete it. If narrowing, consider documenting the If-Match header parameter on the two agenda operations that genuinely take it, so the spec and the sentence agree.

2. SKILL.md IS NOT SERVED. GET /SKILL.md, /llms.txt and /.well-known/ai-plugin.json all return the SPA shell (the catch-all at src/index.ts serves ASSETS for every unmatched path, so a 200 proves nothing). SKILL.md is a repo artifact only. Serving it turns 'ships in the repo' into 'an agent can fetch it from your deployment' — the brief bonus is for an API, and nothing asks for an agent skill at all, so this is unasked-for surface worth making real. Add the route to run_worker_first in wrangler.jsonc if needed (see how /claim/* was fixed in PR #111).

VERIFY AFTER DEPLOY: curl -s .../api/openapi.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['info']['description'])" and curl -s .../SKILL.md | head -3 (must be markdown, not doctype html).

Evidence: sequence/research/DIFFERENTIATION-MATRIX.md, honesty ledger items 1 and 4.
title: The API overclaims optimistic concurrency, and SKILL.md is unreachable
